description: This Java class 'AddMissingAttributesFix' automates the process of adding default width and height attributes to Android XML layout tags that are missing them, ensuring proper layout rendering in the Android Studio environment.

classes.name: AddMissingAttributesFix
classes.description: A class extending WriteCommandAction that adds default width and height attributes to Android XML layout tags missing them, based on parent layout context.

methods.name: findViewsMissingSizes
methods.description: Finds and returns a list of XmlTag elements that require size attributes but are missing them.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Overrides the run method to add default width and height attributes to tags missing them.

methods.name: definesHeight
methods.description: Checks if a given XmlTag defines a height attribute, either explicitly or via style resolution.

methods.name: definesWidth
methods.description: Checks if a given XmlTag defines a width attribute, either explicitly or via style resolution.

methods.name: getDefaultWidth
methods.description: Provides default width value based on parent layout context.

methods.name: getDefaultHeight
methods.description: Provides default height value based on parent layout context.

methods.name: getParentTag
methods.description: Retrieves the parent XmlTag of a given XmlTag.

methods.name: requiresSize
methods.description: Determines if a tag requires size attributes based on its parent and tag name.
